show.description: A self-made tycoon, Deep Shah, hides his roots as the son of a humble security guard. When his father arrives in Mumbai, he’s brutally humiliated by the same elite world Deep now rules. As truth unravels, power flips—exposing class arrogance, testing loyalty, and setting the stage for a ruthless reckoning.
